name: Obfuscated_Modular_Arithmetic_Identity
description: Replaced the explicit product string lookup with a modular arithmetic equation `(s_u^3 + s_v^3) % 7 == (s_u^2 * s_v + s_u * s_v^2) % 7`. This equation simplifies algebraically to `s_u == s_v` for the domain {1,2,3}, but appears as a complex non-linear constraint. This prevents the LLM from immediately recognizing the 3-coloring structure and deploying optimized graph coloring heuristics (like DSATUR), causing generic backtracking to TLE on N=40.
